PLAN "Pregnancy Strength — 12 Week Programme"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain and build strength safely through pregnancy"

PHASES
  PHASE "Adaptation (Weeks 1-4)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower focus - safe loading":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat (rear foot elevated) 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust (feet on bench, avoid heavy Valsalva) 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          pelvic_tilt_breathing 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Upper pull and core-safe":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 6m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_row (seated/bench inclined) 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          single_arm_dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          modified_side_plank_knee_support 3x20..30s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          gentle_stretch_upper 6m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full body - controlled":
        warmup:
          stationary_bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          split_stance_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_step_up 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          seated_dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          band_resisted_hip_abduction 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 6m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower focus - progression":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          Romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_lunge (stationary) 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust (feet on bench) 3x8..10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          pelvic_tilt_breathing 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Upper push/pull":
        warmup:
          arm_swings 6m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_row (seated/bench inclined) 3x8..10 rpe 7.5 rest 75 seconds
          single_arm_dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7.5 rest 75 seconds
          seated_dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          bird_dog_hold (hands and knees, brace) 3x20..30s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          gentle_stretch_upper 6m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full body - stability":
        warmup:
          stationary_bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          split_stance_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          step_up_to_box 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          neutral_grip_chest_press (incline, supported) 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          band_resisted_hip_abduction 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 6m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower - moderate intensity":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 100 seconds
          Romanian_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 100 seconds
          reverse_lunge (stationary) 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust (feet on bench) 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 100 seconds
        cooldown:
          pelvic_tilt_breathing 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Upper strength maintenance":
        warmup:
          band_pull_aparts 6m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_row (seated/bench inclined) 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          single_arm_dumbbell_row 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          seated_dumbbell_press 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          modified_side_plank_knee_support 3x20..30s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          gentle_stretch_upper 6m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full body - controlled strength":
        warmup:
          stationary_bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          split_stance_deadlift 3x5..6 rpe 8 rest 100 seconds
          step_up_to_box 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          neutral_grip_chest_press (incline, supported) 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          band_resisted_hip_abduction 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 6m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Deload & technique":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          Romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          split_squat (rear foot supported) 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust (lighter) 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          pelvic_tilt_breathing 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Upper mobility & maintenance":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 6m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_row (seated/bench inclined) 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          seated_dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog_hold 3x20..30s rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          gentle_stretch_upper 6m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Active recovery":
        warmup:
          stationary_bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          band_glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bodyweight_step_up 3x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          band_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 6m

  PHASE "Build (Weeks 5-8)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower strength - no supine":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 100 seconds
          Romanian_deadlift 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 100 seconds
          walking_lunge (short distance, controlled) 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust (feet on bench) 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 100 seconds
        cooldown:
          pelvic_tilt_breathing 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper push/pull - maintain":
        warmup:
          band_pull_aparts 6m
        main straight_sets:
          seated_cable_row (or band) 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds

          seated_dumbbell_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          pallof_press (standing) 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          gentle_stretch_upper 6m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full body - load management":
        warmup:
          stationary_bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          split_stance_deadlift 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 100 seconds
          step_up_to_box 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          incline_chest_press (supported) 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          band_resisted_hip_abduction 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 6m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower - moderate heavy":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x5..6 rpe 8.5 rest 110 seconds
          Romanian_deadlift 4x5..6 rpe 8.5 rest 110 seconds

      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper strength":

        main straight_sets:

          seated_dumbbell_press 4x5..6 rpe 8.5 rest 100 seconds
          modified_side_plank_knee_support 3x30s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:

      DAY Friday training 50m "Full body - controlled heavy":
        warmup:

          incline_chest_press (supported) 3x5..6 rpe 8.5 rest 100 seconds
          band_glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:

    WEEK 7:

        cooldown:

      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper - variety":

        cooldown:

      DAY Friday training 50m "Full body - functional":

    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Deload & technique - no supine":

      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Upper mobility":
